instructions: Brisk, warm product narration - someone talking a colleague through a screen they built and know well. Keep it moving and slightly ahead of the beat: clip the ends of sentences, one short beat at a comma, never pause for effect, no trailing air. Lift into the important word and drop away at the end of the thought. No announcer tone, no gravitas.
notes: The key is the caption as the recorder logs it; the value is what is spoken.
Measured delivery is about 132 words per minute, or 2.1 words a second. A line
must fit 2.1 x (seconds until the next caption) - 2.5 words, or it has to be
sped up to fit, which crushes the pauses and smears the consonants. Every line
below clears its budget, so no line is ever time-stretched.
One idea per line. No subordinate clauses.
